dedupe_keys.name: 赤ちゃんの駅 railways and stations series on bodik odcs

description: 赤ちゃんの駅 [railways and stations] (series on BODIK ODCS) is a series of datasets listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by BODIK (Open Data Catalogue Service of Japanese local governments). 草津市内の赤ちゃんの駅設置場所の一覧です。. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 8 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The datasets are filed under 8 publishers. Its tags are 位置情報, 子ども, 子育て. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, kml, zip. The portal shows 2024-06-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
